title: Rename apps/architecture-studio's /vtt-generation route to /lab: this surface is generic infrastructure (atomic/integration testing, documentation, eventually Storybook), not VTT-specific -- the VTT heightmap demo is just its first real tenant
objective: Owner-directed correction: 'Nao precisa existir um vtt-generation, eu estou fazendo as coisas para meu VTT porem as coisas terao nomes genericos, porque elas nao servirao apenas para o VTT em si, sera tipo para testar tanto atomicamente as coisas, ou fazer testes de integracao e etc, servira de documentacao e etc.' The owner chose 'lab' (over 'sandbox'/'workbench') as the generic route name via AskUserQuestion. This task performs only the rename (route path + nav label); the owner's further-mentioned intentions (Storybook integration, replacing @grafting/x6-canvas with a React-Flow/xyflow-based canvas per the already-recorded 'Decided' research note, and a not-yet-consolidated unified agent-actions+documents graph view) are explicitly deferred -- the owner said the graph redesign isn't consolidated yet, and did not ask for Storybook or the X6 swap to happen in this message, only for this rename.
validations: DONE: git mv used to rename apps/architecture-studio/src/app/vtt-generation/ to .../lab/ (route path changes from /vtt-generation to /lab), preserving git history for all 3 files.
DONE: studio-nav.tsx's link updated to href=/lab label='Lab'.

DONE: tsc --noEmit and next build both pass (after clearing stale .next/ type-validator cache); all 8 pre-existing unit tests still pass; /, /lab, /agents all return HTTP 200; /vtt-generation correctly 404s now; MCP round-trip still works.
DONE: docs-generate re-run for architecture-studio -- qualified names are filename-based (e.g. 'generation.worker'), not directory-path-based, so the rename produced no incorrect/stale references.
risks: Pure rename, no behavior change to the VTT heightmap demo itself -- it remains real content hosted at the new generic route, not deleted or redesigned.
